description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Jeyathasan as a member of the Karaitivu P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Karaitivu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a new member through a political party nomination process. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral procedures and member declarations for local authorities.
